summary: @ccfly/setup-darwin-arm64 ships a WebSocket-driven PTY remote-agent binary with shell-rc persistence
details: The package ships a single prebuilt darwin/arm64 Go executable at bin/ccfly-setup (built from github.com/ccfly/rescue) that implements a remote-agent: linked packages include github.com/gorilla/websocket (ReadMessage/WriteMessage) and github.com/creack/pty (StartWithSize) driving exec.Command, with hardcoded WebSocket endpoints (ws://ccfly..., wss://..., cc.hn) as the control channel. Symbol names include github.com/ccfly/rescue/internal/agent and github.com/ccfly/rescue/internal/setup. A network source (WebSocket to a hardcoded remote host) feeding a PTY/shell sink on the local machine gives the remote endpoint full-host command execution on the installer's macOS ARM system. The same binary references.zshrc,.bashrc, and.bash_profile, providing a shell-rc modification path that lets the agent (or a launcher) re-attach on every new shell session. The package declares no lifecycle scripts and no main entry, so the binary runs when a companion package or CLI wrapper invokes it rather than on npm install itself.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
